summary: Transforms a 3D point a2 by a 4x4 matrix a3 into output point a1, computing the full homogeneous result (X, Y, Z, w) and then optionally perspective-dividing X/Y/Z by w when FloatRangeCheck reports that w is not approximately 1.0. Returns the output point pointer a1.

operations.description: Compute output X into *a1: a2[0]*a3[0] + a2[1]*a3[4] + a2[2]*a3[8] + a3[12].
Compute the homogeneous w component v9: a2[0]*a3[3] + a2[1]*a3[7] + a2[2]*a3[11] + a3[15].
Call FloatRangeCheck(w, 1.0) to test whether w is approximately 1.0.
When FloatRangeCheck reports w is not approximately 1.0, perspective-divide the output X/Y/Z components by w; otherwise they are left verbatim.
Perspective divide: multiply *a1, a1[1] and a1[2] by 1.0 / w when the divide path is taken.
Return the output point pointer a1.
